response.sql: WITH per_transaction AS (SELECT transref, AVG(anlycount) AS avg_coverage FROM sentimentandfundamentals GROUP BY transref), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_coverage) AS overall_avg FROM per_transaction), kept AS (SELECT p.transref, p.avg_coverage, o.overall_avg FROM per_transaction AS p CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE p.avg_coverage > o.overall_avg), kept_average AS (SELECT AVG(avg_coverage) AS kept_avg FROM kept) SELECT k.transref, k.avg_coverage, k.avg_coverage - k.overall_avg AS above_overall_average, k.avg_coverage - a.kept_avg AS above_kept_average FROM kept AS k CROSS JOIN kept_average AS a ORDER BY (k.avg_coverage - a.kept_avg) IS NULL, (k.avg_coverage - a.kept_avg) DESC LIMIT 10;
